article.headline: SE Louisiana earns 73-72 win against North Dakota
article.description: — Tyler Rolison scored 22 points, including the go-ahead basket with sevn seconds remaining, and SE Louisiana beat North Dakota 73-72 at the Cancun Challenge on Wednesday.
article.linkText: SE Louisiana earns 73-72 win against North Dakota

categories.description: SE Louisiana Lions @ North Dakota Fighting Hawks

event.description: SE Louisiana Lions @ North Dakota Fighting Hawks

keywords: SE Louisiana Lions @ North Dakota Fighting Hawks
article.story: CANCUN, Mexico -- — Tyler Rolison scored 22 points, including the go-ahead basket with sevn seconds remaining, and SE Louisiana beat North Dakota 73-72 at the Cancun Challenge on Wednesday. Rolison had three steals for the Lions (3-4). Yanis Ndjonga scored 18 points while going 7 of 11 and 4 of 7 from the free-throw line, and added seven rebounds and three steals. Garrett Shoemaker had 15 points and finished 6 of 7 from the field. Jayden Moore led the Fightin’ Hawks (4-4) in scoring, finishing with 24 points and five assists. North Dakota also got 14 points and two steals from Tyler Wagner. Samuel Hincapie also had 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
